entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: A young woman of the Kingdom of Khone, one of the Numbered Ones and its most powerful wizard, who sought to avenge her home.

entities.name: Kingdom of Khone
entities.description: Kingdom on Dominaria destroyed by Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: The Swamp King who destroyed Khone in a rage.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A planeswalker who rode the summoned Scarzam Dragon and attacked Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Chondaeh
entities.description: Of the Kingdom of Shikar, allied with Gydolien.

entities.name: Numbered Ones
entities.description: A group of wizards of Khone.

events.summary: Gydolien is determined the most powerful wizard in Khone after a magical exercise with the other Numbered Ones.
events.quote: she was determined to be the most powerful wizard in Khone

events.summary: After fifteen years Gydolien and Chondaeh summon the dragon with Sivitri on its back, who attacks Sol'Kanar.
Sol'Kanar destroys the Kingdom of Khone, leaving Gydolien the only living Khonian.
events.quote: leaving Gydolien the only living Khonian

relations.quote: she allied with Chondaeh from the Kingdom of Shikar

relations.note: She vowed vengeance for Khone's destruction.
relations.quote: She then focused her attention on avenging her home.
